fixes: a detector stop carries the latest tool result
a stopped helper returns 'stopped: no progress, do not re-delegate'
a subtask already stopped is not handed to a new helper
notes: Two reps per case. The model is not deterministic, so a one-run swing (for example the harness alone going from 8.5 to 15.5 calls on sprawl-3) is noise, not a trend.

noprog-3 passes because the stop message now carries the last tool value. The stop text says 'Nothing new came back', and the success check's FAIL word list matches 'nothing', so this pass is partly check-sensitive. The check was not changed.
A saver stop message counts as operator-visible text only when the main agent was stopped. Helper stop messages go to the planner and are not counted.
Before the final run, one smoke run (noprog-3 and sprawl-2, 1 rep, both arms, about $0.06) checked the plumbing. It is not in these results but is in the spend.
The 'before' columns are the v2 runs for the same cases, from a different day and different samples.
